title: Demosaic
text: Demosaic Bayer format images, 1 input, 4 outputs, {Sensor alignment} sets R,G,B pixel alignment; {Interpolation algorithm}, {Output image signal} sets the dimensions of output image One multidimensional and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: R
ports.summary: Red color channel of processed image matrix

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Green color channel of processed image matrix

ports.name: B
ports.summary: Blue color channel of processed image matrix

params.name: Sensor alignment
params.values: R,G,B pixel alignment RGGB (default) | GRBG | GBRG | BGGR

params.name: Output image signal
params.values: Dimensions of output image One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
